estimands.candidate_exclusion: Remove 1/5/10 largest portfolio identities only from selectable controls, retain all source scenarios and endpoint denominators; no inference of bot/person or trustworthiness.
estimands.email_hash_sensitivity: Group identical stored email hashes as a hypothetical control unit; identity linkage not independently established; budget is groups and scenario denominator changes.
estimands.endpoint_coverage: C(S)=|union_{m in S} E_m|, prospective structural reach of selected hardening/review scenarios. A covered endpoint can still be exposed through any unhardened source.
estimands.full_protection: P(S)=|{e: A_e is nonempty and A_e subset S}| with A_e={m:e in E_m}. Residual possible exposure is full reachable universe minus P. Structural all-source exclusion, not a security guarantee.
estimands.repository_endpoint: Case-folded owner/repo, trailing .git removed; union over positively flagged package-version mappings; distinct repositories deduplicate monorepos.
estimands.scenario_exposure_reduction: H(S)=sum_{m in S}|E_m|/sum_m|E_m|. Uniform mutually exclusive identity-loss scenarios, hardening a selected source prevents that source scenario; other scenarios unaffected. No empirical scenario probabilities.
estimands.uncertainty: Random mean, SD and central 95% empirical simulation range describe random-baseline variability; deterministic snapshot results have no sampling confidence interval.
estimands.workflow_presence: Any observed package-version row with positive GitHub workflow flag; does not imply secret access, exploitability, code execution, or historical presence.

graph: All stored version edges collapsed to directed package adjacency; reverse reach includes seed portfolios; SCC condensation with exact integer bitsets
limitations: Convenience snapshot with no shared collection cutoff; not full npm population or a temporal causal design.
Package union can combine incompatible versions; collector did not preserve extraction-root provenance.
Registry maintainer membership does not establish active publishing permissions, token scopes, shared credential control, or attack probabilities.
Graph reach indicates possible structural dependency paths and does not establish exploit propagation or CI secret access.
Workflow absence/unknown and repository metadata gaps are observational missingness, not demonstrated safety.
Exact greedy coverage and exact maintainer union are established methods, not a new optimization algorithm.
No incident labels, prediction, model fitting, expected real-world incidents, or causal security effects are claimed.
random_generator: Python random.Random; independent seeds 0..trials-1; same sampled orders across endpoints
source_database_mode: Extracted in temporary directory, immutable read-only SQLite connection; source archive unmodified
study: Exact structural identity-hardening and endpoint-coverage comparison
tie_policy: Descending score then ascending username Unicode order; reverse-order aggregate sensitivity included; no names released
